fields.description: Leave EMPTY for a walk-in paying at the desk - then Customer Name is the identity that prints.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: Fetched from the account when one is set; free text for a walk-in.
fields.label: Customer Name

fields.description: Walk-ins only - contact number for session issues. Staff-visible (PLAN 8j).
fields.label: Customer Phone

fields.description: Entry fee charged to this participant before discount.
fields.label: Fee

fields.description: The platform's per-participant fee on top of the session fee (Per Booking companies only; 0 on a Free entry). Printed as its own line on the participant's billing document.
fields.label: Platform Fee

fields.description: The channel this entry was paid through (Cash channel, GCash, a bank). Chosen when the player is added; staff may correct it when confirming a transfer.
fields.label: Payment Channel

fields.description: Cash and Free are paid on the spot; Fund Transfer stays Unpaid until staff confirm it. Open play payments carry NO verification clocks — participants are physically present.
fields.label: Payment Status

fields.description: Fund-transfer proof uploaded by staff on the participant's behalf.
fields.label: Payment Proof
